artist: Jammer feat. Wiley, D Double E, Kano and Durrty Goodz
title: Destruction VIP
label: JahmekTheWorld
format: Vinyl (format per FACT not stated); compilation CD 2005
producers: Jammer (implied; not explicitly credited in sources opened)

type.basis: Evidence specimen; a posse track later compiled on Run the Road.

sound.text: Multi-MC posse track (no instrumental detail given).
Jammer's productions generally: reggae bass weight fused with garage double-time; 'future-industrial' basslines.

context.text: FACT ranks it no. 12 in 'The 20 best Grime records ever made', calling it grime's 'Rapper's Delight'.
Listed on the Run the Road tracklist in Chantelle Fiddy's blog, 25 Oct 2004.
Jammer: Leytonstone, East London; basement studio in his family home; formerly producer for N.A.S.T.Y. Crew.

uncertainty: Run the Road release date: Wikipedia gives 24 Jan 2005; Chantelle Fiddy (Oct 2004) said due mid-November 2004; PopMatters gives 8 March 2005 (likely US). Original 'Destruction' not verified.
tracklist: Posse cut; track 5 on Run the Road (3:16).
